Owner: /root/fresh_disk_gap_relief. Independent finding after the PR127 body-read fix, official v0.74.19 source7606924, was installed. PublishRefs updates Git refs without synchronously updating query metadata; a changed or racy generation makes the next indexed task query capture namespace tips and diff them to discover an already-known own mutation. In the actual fresh-CLI CI proof with32/10000 tasks and three consecutive unique creates without re-priming, read/open bounds passed while pread grew from46-47 to303-307. Bytes and exclusive source attribution remain unmeasured; do not call total IO constant. Evidence: ccn129-consecutive-a99efb2.log, ccn129-productionlike-f826888.log; internal/store/store.go PublishRefs, query_source.go currentGeneration/capture, query_delta.go diffQueryMetadata. Next: measure actual query-index bytes and visited-tip work in CI, then propose a bounded incremental known-tip update using existing utilities, preserving external-write/crash/race invalidation and the unavailable-index path. No new watcher, daemon or custom journal without a concrete reviewed design. This follow-up does not hold independent body/cache gates.

Source diagnosis: currentGeneration intentionally refuses generation certification for2s after filesystem mutation; existing regression requires this. Exact per-ref CAS does not exclude other namespace writers. No unsafe generation advancement. Measurement draft: ccn-query-index-byte-measurement-input.json (4frozen files, CI-only returned syscall bytes including children and separately query DB FD paths; test-only capture/diff callsite work counts). Isolated speculative partial row delta: ccn-query-index-row-delta-input.json (3files); reuses strict task snapshot/projector/replace in existing index, always deletes generation key; authority and all-namespace residual remain. Source review and paired work/byte/netwrite benefit required before shipping. Current next step: reconcile independent source review, parser restart accounting and own proof HOME-env correction; coalesce a single next required cache CI measurement. Body.19 installed natural create passed; cache2d remains independently open. No local tests/builds or new CI for these drafts.
